title: Interactive mesh deadlock investigation
summary: Connected backend deadlock information to channel, route and canvas views for engineering diagnosis.

dates.note: First inspected milestone: 2025-08-28. See facts for earlier/later feature stages; this is neither proof of first-ever work nor a formal role/leadership start or shipped release date.

facts.text: Created CMN GUI tooling for custom routing and mesh deadlock investigation.
Built global/scoped deadlock checks, channel and subchannel selection, loop inspection, crosspoint/turn summaries, route inspection and mesh-canvas integration.
Connected channel/subchannel route filtering and permissible-turn selection to scoped deadlock loops, crosspoint summaries and editable mesh routes.
The engine deadlock-analysis algorithm predates Michael’s investigation GUI; contribution evidence supports routing/diagnostic integration and visualization, not original authorship of the detector.

notes: The original Configuration Engine deadlock-analysis algorithm belongs to other engineers; this record covers investigation and visualization workflows.

2026-10-27 local Git/source research supplements prior evidence. Authorship supports attributable implementation; shared components and later colleague changes retain separate ownership. No employer tests were rerun.
